# volcano_storage_bucket_policy (Resource)

A row-level access policy for a storage bucket, evaluated at request time for one operation. There is no update endpoint - every attribute change replaces it. There is also no single-policy GET; Read reconciles by listing the bucket's policies and matching on id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_storage_bucket_policy" "owner_only_select" {
  project_id  = volcano_project.example.id
  bucket_name = volcano_storage_bucket.avatars.name
  name        = "owner-only-select"
  operation   = "SELECT"
  definition  = "auth.uid() = owner_id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String)
- `definition` (String) Policy expression evaluated at request time, e.g. "auth.uid() = owner_id".
- `name` (String) Unique within the bucket.
- `operation` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_storage_bucket_policy.owner_only_select <project-id>,<bucket-name>,<policy-id>
```
